new_tasks.name: hive/operator-resume
new_tasks.title: Record explicit implementation resume and fresh eligible execution scope
acceptance: The user explicitly resumes implementation; this planning request does not discharge the gate.
Bind current actor, fresh risk portfolio, permitted scope and clock; no deployment authority is conferred.
Do not auto-complete from a model suggestion, Sa-plan availability, board ACK or existing full-access authorization that predates the pause.
new_tasks.payoff: Existing pause must be explicitly lifted before implementation.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: No product change; record resume evidence once.

new_tasks.name: hive/control-recovery
new_tasks.title: Reconcile stopped worker, uncertain effects and stale grant identities
acceptance: Observe exact current task attempt, lease, coordinator epoch, process identity, clock and durable intent/result pairs before any reclaim.
Classify every relevant effect as known-success, known-failure or unresolved; reconcile unresolved outcomes before retry.
Use applicable expired-claim preflight and stable logical effect IDs; do not force another worker's ownership or delete historical records.
Prepare only the finite independently reviewed grant needed to finish the existing RECEIPT_FIX and MCP_ACTIVATE tasks; bind current loaded module identities.
Resolve the handover chronology discrepancy against observed UTC and receipts; retain the original handover unchanged.
new_tasks.payoff: Stopped ownership and stale grants prevent trustworthy execution.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Reconcile existing attempts only; do not reimplement the receipt repair.

new_tasks.name: hive/reuse-evidence/control-accept
new_tasks.title: Independently verify repaired harness in a fresh process
acceptance: An independent reviewer checks exact source and actual red/green assertions, including empty, short, long ASCII and Unicode byte-bound fallback cases.
A fresh process using the reviewed current grant exercises initialization, scoped read/write/readback, build/test, clock, heartbeat, release and recovery.
An independent client hashes actual retained UTF-8 bytes of a real long-output receipt and matches output_retained_sha256 and byte counts; output_sha256 remains documented as full-output digest.
Missing grant, changed identity, out-of-scope path, stale attempt, expired lease, duplicate intent and lost reply all produce the specified refusal or reconciled outcome.
Do not infer fresh runtime acceptance from the old live harness's reported 84-test pass.
new_tasks.payoff: Fresh-process acceptance is essential but already belongs to MCP_ACTIVATE.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Consume the same independent evidence; no duplicate build, test suite or implementation.

new_tasks.name: hive/planning-mcp
new_tasks.title: Provide typed canonical planning and evidence publication through MCP
acceptance: Define a closed Gleam PlanningIntent algebra for create-plan, create-task and publish-evidence; reuse the canonical Sa-plan bridge and bounded file primitives.
Every intent carries stable effect ID and a trusted task/session binding; caller-supplied backend, SQL, shell command, role and identity cannot grant authority.
Return a typed applied/refused/uncertain result with canonical readback and evidence digest; retry preserves exactly-once logical intent semantics.
A real client creates and reads a sandbox plan/task and publishes a scoped timestamped journal through MCP; verify failure and lost-reply behavior.
Archive this bounded metadata bootstrap as an explicit exception; subsequent planning/publication uses the verified ingress.
new_tasks.payoff: Missing canonical plan/journal writes caused repeated manual bootstrap and block the requested MCP workflow.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: One small typed planning/publication vertical slice; reuse Sa-plan and bounded file adapters.

new_tasks.name: hive/covered-by-core/readiness-census
new_tasks.title: Reconcile actual services, agents, features and existing work without duplicate registries
acceptance: Observe actual agent sessions, OTP applications/processes, service units, ports, native libraries, toolchains and required capability bindings without printing secrets.
Reuse the existing feature DB; identify its real schema and authority before any migration. Do not create another tracker.
Map every required feature to implementation, MCP and any admitted mesh exposure, responsible task, candidate and current evidence; preserve unavailable and unknown states.
Treat historical 21-service/357-obligation figures as specification baseline; enumerate the actual current runtime set and justify differences.
For every observed service/capability create all 17 canonical aspect dispositions and L0-L9 applicability entries: direct, inherited with evidence, N/A with review, or UNKNOWN.
new_tasks.payoff: A bounded inventory is necessary; a separate universal census project is not.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Include only the first workflow dependencies and existing feature DB entries in SERVICE_VERIFY.

new_tasks.name: hive/conditional/native-boundary-repair
new_tasks.title: Repair demonstrated service health and native-boundary defects
acceptance: Write independent failing oracles for each observed health fallthrough: absent source, command failure, unhealthy container, missing verification evidence and unsupported topic count must not become nominal/success.
Inventory scheduler class, bounded duration, ownership/lifetime and actual ABI/load behavior per required NIF; move blocking OS/network work behind supervised isolated services owned by Gleam.
Exercise representative ZigVM deterministic/VFS confinement, bounded Hermes workers and isolated MAX protocol only where required by the accepted profile.
Preserve the denied system-OS storage serial; tests use fixtures/refusal paths and never allocate or wipe a physical device.
Fix only demonstrated gaps and rerun affected behavior tests; if a boundary already conforms, retain the evidence instead of refactoring it.
new_tasks.payoff: Repair only an observed blocker, unsafe boundary or false-success path used by the current slice.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Unknown/failed dependency remains unavailable until fixed; no blanket NIF redesign.

new_tasks.name: hive/covered-by-core/scheduler-gates
new_tasks.title: Enforce task eligibility and truthful planning projection at effect time
acceptance: Distinguish canonical task state from risk eligibility, global pause, lease freshness and component evidence; status views must agree on source and observation time.
Recheck current owner/attempt/epoch, prerequisite acceptance and evidence freshness at effect dispatch; preflight receipts alone do not establish atomic enforcement.
Demonstrate rejection of task available + risk HOLD, completed review + HOLD verdict, expired heartbeat with live lease, changed source, missing dependency evidence and concurrent claims.
Exercise durable job/workflow cancellation, bounded retry and compensation through Sa-plan; acknowledge unsupported semantics rather than claim Oban/Temporal parity from names.
Generate dashboard status from canonical data; no independent writable completion queue.
new_tasks.payoff: Authority and stale-worker refusal are non-negotiable; a scheduler rewrite is not yet justified.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Verify existing fences in MCP_ACTIVATE/HIVE_VERIFY; open a scoped repair only for a demonstrated failure.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/capability-parity
new_tasks.title: Close required MCP capability gaps with declarative functional interfaces
acceptance: For each required inventoried capability expose a typed MCP intent or read projection with finite parameters, result/error algebra, policy, resource bounds and supervised backend.
Keep deterministic decisions pure and isolate effects; no generic unrestricted shell, eval or raw SQL facade.
Use registry-derived contract tests across discovery, authorization, real runtime binding, unsupported/refused cases and transport equivalence for admitted alternate ingress.
Verify every required agent and native capability through actual clients; loaded configuration, tool declaration, NIF load and successful operation are distinct evidence.
Full readiness requires all required capabilities verified; a reviewed reduced profile is DEGRADED and lists exclusions explicitly.
new_tasks.payoff: Full MCP parity remains the overall goal, but exposing all unused features upfront has uncertain immediate payoff.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Grow one required capability end to end; retain remaining features as explicit backlog.

new_tasks.name: hive/covered-by-core/fault-recovery
new_tasks.title: Verify hive supervision, persistence and cross-agent failure recovery
acceptance: Fault injection uses isolated development stores, ports and owned processes, bounded duration and tested stop/recovery commands.
Exercise interruption before dispatch, during effect, after durable commit/before reply, and after reply/before follow-up; compare against an independent durable-state oracle.
Kill and restart a worker; lose coordination/store connectivity; expire leases; duplicate and reorder messages; test a partitioned peer and stale leader.
Verify single-effect outcome, no stale writer, bounded restart/queue behavior, eventual progress after recovery and sanitized causal trace.
Record observed recovery time and any lost or uncertain work; do not infer replication/consensus from OTP supervision.
new_tasks.payoff: Core crash and lost-reply recovery are necessary; a complete federation chaos programme is not a first-use prerequisite.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Test bounded interruption/duplicate cases in HIVE_VERIFY; add partition depth when the operating profile uses it.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/operator-surfaces
new_tasks.title: Verify consistent accessible operator surfaces and live evidence projections
acceptance: Project the same task/effect/authorization meaning through required web, API, TUI, AG-UI SSE and admitted mesh surfaces; document unavailable surfaces explicitly.
Use typed declarative components; reject arbitrary executable model markup, unauthorized state changes and private data disclosure.
On the actual candidate verify HTTP status, final route, page identity, visible evidence state, keyboard/mobile checklist usability and rendered/raw parity.
Test sanitized event sequence, authenticated subscription, reconnect cursor, bounded buffering/backpressure and expired evidence display.
Use the current 18-checkpoint navigation contract plus provenance domain; actual browser screenshots require inspection, and fixture-injected pages cannot substitute for real route behavior.
new_tasks.payoff: Accurate status and accessible primary controls are core; every UI component/surface is a later expansion.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Repair primary planning/evidence views only when they block or mislead the actual workflow.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/perf-scale
new_tasks.title: Measure bounded development and Telegram workloads including saturation and soak
acceptance: Precommit workload mix, concurrency ramp, payload distribution, warm-up, duration, host identity and resource ceilings before executing the benchmark.
Freeze required throughput, p95/p99 latency, error/uncertainty rate, queue age, RSS, recovery and cost limits in a reviewed profile; missing numerical thresholds block acceptance.
Measure p50/p95/p99, throughput, process/mailbox/queue depth, CPU, RSS, store contention and rejected work at increasing concurrency and at saturation.
Verify bounded backpressure and fairness, preserve failures, then run recovery and the 24-hour operational soak required by the existing Telegram campaign.
Sequential parser loops and one aggregate timing are not concurrency/scalability evidence; rerun only changed or inconclusive workload slices.
new_tasks.payoff: Resource bounds and a baseline smoke load are core; broad scale and soak have value after correctness.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Run targeted baseline in HIVE_VERIFY; preserve the full Telegram soak for its operational campaign.

new_tasks.name: hive/covered-by-core/formal-evidence
new_tasks.title: Bind executable laws and applicable bounded formal checks to current candidates
acceptance: Extract laws for intent idempotency, receipt-byte integrity, exclusive writer/lease, authorization noninterference, budget conservation and trace-coordinate preservation from actual implementations.
Map each applicable law to property tests, independent oracle and actual bounded formal invocation; state method, assumptions, toolchain, timeout and candidate.
Run solver/prover workers with bounds and satisfiable controls; missing tools, timeout, unsupported syntax, sorry/Admitted or undeclared axioms fail closed.
Keep finite executable checks, bounded model checks and general proofs distinct; textual checklist validation never substitutes for a proof-engine run.
new_tasks.payoff: Applicable authority/receipt laws and independent oracles are core; universal proof work is not an automatic gate.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Use invocation-specific relevant properties in MCP_ACTIVATE/HIVE_VERIFY; deepen only for risk or a changed guarantee.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/telegram-accept
new_tasks.title: Accept the existing Telegram campaign using current operational evidence
acceptance: Reuse plan uos/telegram-fractal-tests/20261027-0312; this task is an evidence-consumption gate, not a second campaign queue.
Machine-check required external task states AND accepted candidate-bound evidence; cross-plan prerequisites are not natively enforced by the current DAG and must fail closed at this gate.
Replace fabricated successful adapter replies and crash-only security loops with independent assertions; verify identity, authority, routing and real service effects.

Verify durable inbox/outbox progression, duplicate delivery, uncertain send outcome, media bounds, restart and observer errors; reconcile all seven carried AUTO findings by exact locator and evidence.
Perform human-operated actual-client journeys with explicit numeric test identity and recipient/message scope; no production sends or legacy polling overlap under a development grant.
Consume the performance/scalability and operational-soak results, preserving full scenario and coverage dispositions.
new_tasks.payoff: Telegram verification remains required for the stated Telegram goal, separate from initial editor/build hive usability.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Execute the existing Telegram plan once the control path is safe; no duplicate campaign.

new_tasks.name: hive/covered-by-core/cost-efficiency
new_tasks.title: Validate agent selection, budgets and useful work per resource
acceptance: Reobserve real AGY models, modes, quota and measured eligibility; prefer Google execution under the user preference and record any authorized fallback.
Compare candidates on the same bounded acceptance task; choose the cheapest capable option after correctness, safety and criticality gates, with actual token/latency/cost receipts.
Unknown or uncertain charges remain liabilities; enforce existing explicit aggregate OpenRouter USD10/UTC-day ceiling without enabling paid calls merely for evaluation.
Bound concurrent agents and expensive builds; stop retrying quota failures and avoid new contexts, duplicate reviews or repeated passing suites without evidence value.
Report useful verified work, rework, blocked time and total resource cost; do not claim an optimal model from a catalog alone.
new_tasks.payoff: Measure cost and rework on useful tasks; a separate all-model benchmark has no demonstrated payoff.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Record per-slice tokens, latency, retries, failures and useful output; compare models only when a routing decision needs evidence.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/knowledge-sync
new_tasks.title: Reconcile current evidence, rules and knowledge graph without rewriting history
acceptance: Map requirements, implementation, candidate, tasks, formal contracts, scenarios and evidence to existing Wiki/ZK/ontology and dashboard projections.
Use current source artifacts to classify unverifiable EV evidence; never mint EVs above93 or turn historical claims into admission.
Investigate KMP-ENTROPY before changing tags; any retagging must reflect substantive layer ownership, not merely satisfy the numerical threshold.
Verify Tailscale FQDN links, rendered/raw parity, navigation, keyboard/mobile checklist access and sanitized evidence visibility on actual pages.
All new or changed explanatory diagrams have equivalent editable ASCII and Mermaid sources; preserve historical originals.
new_tasks.payoff: Current rules/skills/SOP correctness and task journals are core; entropy/global historical cleanup is separate.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Repair active references and contradictions in AGENT_PARITY; defer unrelated retagging and EV documentation projects.

new_tasks.name: hive/backlog/dev-ready-review
new_tasks.title: Independently accept full development hive against the frozen coverage profile
acceptance: A reviewer independent of implementation verifies exact candidate and all required per-capability/per-aspect evidence, expiry, residual risks and rollback.

For every observed service/capability each AINF-A01..A17 and applicable L0..L9 cell has a direct or inherited evidence reference; justified N/A is reviewed; UNKNOWN/UNRUN/STALE/HOLD cannot pass a required cell.
A real operator-to-MCP-to-Sa-plan-to-agent-to-service-to-independent-review workflow completes, then recovers from an interrupted worker without an unauthorized or duplicate effect.
Require zero unresolved outcomes and conflicting active writers in the accepted profile; no open P0/P1 for included capabilities.
Record READY only when all required providers/features pass. DEGRADED or HOLD must name exclusions and may not be presented as fully functional.
No production admission, new EV claim or review-by-ACK is implied.
new_tasks.payoff: A full-profile acceptance milestone is useful later; independent review of the first slice already exists in HIVE_VERIFY.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: First verdict is scoped CORE_DEV_READY or HOLD; full-profile readiness awaits its real feature/operational evidence.

new_tasks.name: hive/conditional/dev-integrate
new_tasks.title: Integrate reviewed candidate and publish reproducible development entrypoint
acceptance: Take separate integration ownership; preserve unrelated working changes and use standalone JJ feature/integration bookmarks and immutable candidate identities.
Observe build/test/evidence scope after integration and rerun affected checks only when candidate content, build environment or runtime changed.
Publish the verified development startup, agent enrollment, MCP capability discovery, stop/recovery, evidence readback and rollback commands with prerequisites.
Demonstrate reproducibility using already-realized pinned inputs or authorized Tailnet fetches; no implicit public package fetch, external tree mutation or model-weight ingestion.
Serialize any operator-authorized main integration after required acceptance; production deployment remains governed by its own release/state authority.
Emit SC-JOURNAL-v3 completion ledger and verify canonical task/evidence readback before announcing development readiness.
new_tasks.payoff: Reviewed source integration and rollback are necessary when the slice changes source.
new_tasks.narrowed_scope: Use existing serialized JJ process after candidate review; no new deployment mechanism or production cutover.

Isolated candidate, finite resources, preserved baseline
Tested rollback and independent promotion review
